svg.title: Perineal incision shapes
svg.desc: Midline, inverted-U and lambda incisions illustrate different ways to obtain perineal exposure. Choice depends on exposure, prior scars, patient anatomy and reconstruction. View: Male perineum, inferior view; scrotum anterior. Scale: Conceptual schematic; not to scale. Units: No measured geometry; any dimensions are illustrative. Clinical review pending; no named clinician has signed off. Concept sources: EAU Urethral Strictures: disease management in males (2026 web guideline), https://uroweb.org/guidelines/urethral-strictures/chapter/disease-management-in-males; access: official full text; Indications and reconstructive principles; not a validation of every drawn tissue plane. WARWIKI original vector schematic; individual illustrator not recorded. No separate figure reuse license recorded; linked sources are concept references, not artwork licenses.

svg.text: Perineal skin incisions for bulbar / posterior urethroplasty
Incision choice depends on exposure, prior scars and reconstruction; shapes are not a risk ranking
perineum viewed from below — anterior (scrotum) above, posterior (anus, ●) below
